audience: clinics that manage consultations and the agenda in SmartDoctor

useCases.title: Check the agenda for a day or a status
useCases.text: List the clinic's appointments from a start date. Filter by status, and open one appointment to read its time and doctor.

useCases.title: Find open slots for a specialty
useCases.text: List the open time slots per doctor for one specialty. Check the price list before you offer a visit.

useCases.title: Book a consultation at an open time
useCases.text: Book a consultation. Without a time, the first open time of the day is used. The specialty needs a self-pay price and a schedule on that date.

useCases.title: Move or cancel an appointment
useCases.text: Move an appointment to a new date and time that is open. Or cancel it, which keeps the appointment in the clinic's records.
